kind: scientific skill/API client and workflow toolkit

runtime.execution: Host-loadable skills and normal Python NIM HTTP clients; aggregate plugin generator and evaluation scaffolding.
runtime.service_boundary: Consumes NVIDIA hosted or independently deployed NIMs; prompts also describe Docker setup if service absent. Client does not implement NIM inference or host agent loop.

summary: scientific service skills, generated catalog and concrete request/result preservation helpers

inspection.scope: source-skill discovery/sync/scanner, ProteinMPNN mode/input/HTTP/result/failure paths and exact-response/concurrent-output tests; local Harbor grader and pipeline guidance
inspection.limits: Other NIM adapters/catalog listed, not all manually traced; live GPU/hosted evals unavailable and not run.

actions.name: discover_source_skills() / plugin_sync.py --check|--write
actions.output: Leaf name/path map; coverage/freshness diagnostics or rebuilt aggregate
actions.lifecycle: Offline packaging; signature/eval artifacts preserved by generator contract

actions.name: design.py --pdb --mode --num-sequences --output-dir
actions.input: PDB, parameters, endpoint mode, credential and new output directory
actions.output: request.json, response.raw/response.json, designed_sequences.fa and summary with native/design score alignment
actions.lifecycle: One synchronous POST; atomic directory reservation prevents duplicate output collisions; non200 incl202 fails, no async job handle
actions.authority: Client invokes existing selected NIM; hosted key/local noauth, prompt transfer consent

actions.name: design_results(result, expected_count)
actions.lifecycle: Pure bounded result interpretation; no invented missing scores

actions.name: drug-discovery-pipeline
actions.input: Target, starting scaffold, scoring objective and service mode/ports
actions.output: Generated molecules, docking and affinity prediction stages
actions.lifecycle: External service sequence; no autonomous scheduler or shared namespace guarantee

actions.name: scan_skills.py
actions.input: Source skills, optional changed paths/base ref and report directory
actions.output: Per-skill JSON risk reports and aggregate exit/status summary
actions.lifecycle: Subprocess scan each selected skill; completes even after one failure
actions.authority: CI/contributor process authority; external SkillSpector composition

evidence.claim: Generated payload coverage/freshness contract; recursively discover leaf skills, reject duplicate names, exclude vendor/evals.
Host tool frontmatter, hosted/local authority/data transfer and existing service consumer boundary.
FASTA/result parser checks finite scores, design/native separation and rejects count/score mismatches.
Explicit mode/key/baseURL and numeric/PDB validation before request.
Atomic output reservation, request JSON and exact HTTP response bytes; only200 produces valid complete summary and exact FASTA.
CLI options and separate request/failure exit statuses; read timeout is not server cancellation.
Prompt workflow composes GenMol→DiffDock→Boltz2; port/lifetime assumptions explicitly distinguished.
Hosted skill-lift evaluation with external trajectory+LLM grader; local tasks described TODO/unsupported and some timeouts explicitly pending.
Literal score/native/chain validation and malformed result rejection.
Mock HTTP exact request/result/failure bytes and secret omission oracles.
Directory rejection and controlled concurrent reservation test only one request.
Shipped grader checks artifact/request/response shape, trajectory endpoint strings and seeded local replay with partial credit; not scientific design efficacy.
Scanner finishes selected skills and aggregates risk/suppression/completeness reports; risk threshold is not scientific validity.

tests.focus: FASTA native/design alignment, exact IO/failure, secret omission, atomic concurrency
tests.oracle: Literal expected sequences/scores, rejection arrays, preserved bytes and single mocked request under a controlled race. Does not test NIM science.

tests.focus: Shipped local grader source; README support remains TODO
tests.oracle: Shape/parameter/endpoint substring and seeded replay; partial credit possible. Reproduction is not design efficacy, and trajectory string presence is weak execution evidence. Not run.

strengths: Request/result artifacts preserve exact response bytes and score identities; failures do not fabricate completion.
Atomic new-run directory plus direct literal/concurrent tests address meaningful client fault classes.
limits: Client timeout does not prove server quiescence, and202 is rejected rather than tracked.
Scientific inference quality and supported native local-agent evaluations are not established by helper tests or replay.
arconaut_questions: How can a consumer expose exact service IO, remote identity and quiescence independently of the scientific service governor?
Which domain transformations need literal identity/alignment oracles, and which require independent biological evaluation?
